hook.text: A vendor adds a new column to their API response. Your pipeline ignores it. Months of data, lost.

buildup.text: Schema drift happens when a data source changes structure without coordinating with consumers.

discovery.text: Drift can add columns, rename fields, change types, or remove columns entirely.

twist.text: Unlike crashes, schema drift often goes unnoticed until someone queries the missing data.

climax.text: Schema validation checks at ingestion catch drift immediately, before damage spreads.

punchline.text: Detect drift at the door, not at the dashboard.

quiz.question: What is schema drift?
options: When a data source changes structure without warning
When a pipeline runs too slowly
